text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hah!? T-The weight class has changed...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Man, gotta do something about this...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's why I'm tryin' so desperately 
like this.”

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Still, a weight-loss method straight from 
someone with experience is truly something 
else. I can feel my body toning up right 
before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Though I had a heck of a time gettin' 
it outta my old man."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'll have to slim down before anyone 
notices.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, for a while I'm gonna stick to 
the weight-loss method my pops taught me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Wonder Acute used incredible 
focus to slim down, and safely returned to 
her original weight class... er, original 
weight.
